summary:
Resna and her companions head toward the northern frontier, an unknown territory, gathering information along the way. When asked to help solve problems on an island during their journey, they readily agree, unable to ignore those in need. However, Liebe—one of the Miraculous Nine who prioritizes reaching World's End above all else—stands in Resna's path. After defeating Liebe and somehow resolving the problems they were asked to help with, the party is confronted by Citrine, who asks Resna about her purpose. Resna answers, "I want to make everyone happy."

Continuing through the islands, Heidi and her old acquaintance Caroline join them, and they finally reach the northernmost island, "Obenland." There, Resna and her companions learn of the Sea of Eternal Night to the north—the Midnight Sea—and the Apexi Ripplegharm. Fully prepared, they venture into the Midnight Sea and succeed in defeating Ripplegharm, but are forced to retreat when faced with the threat of successive Apexi-class monsters that continue to appear.

Returning to Obenland, Resna and her companions discover that a painting they found on a wrecked ship—the "Painting of the Miraculous Nine"—is a new clue to reaching World's End, and they are already eager to try again. Meanwhile, Alvina's heart had been broken by fear. Believing that she will return after parting ways with them, Resna and her companions begin searching for all nine paintings said to exist of the Miraculous Nine.

Returning to the sacred lands, Alvina struggles with her inability to keep up with her dreams. However, after receiving advice from Caroline and the others, she decides to undergo training. Challenging the "Trial Caverns" together with Bepp and the others, Alvina is finally able to overcome the fear within herself.

Several months later, Alvina rejoins Resna and her companions. Though she hasn't completely conquered her fear, she says she wants to accompany them on their journey again, and Resna and the others welcome her with smiles. The Paintings of the Nine that the party seeks now number three: the one Resna's group obtained in Keiun, and the one Alvina brought back from the Cavern of Trials.
